I am an AI researcher, solutions architect, and consultant specializing in Deep Neural Network architecture design, gradient optimization, and AI product engineering — retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent execution graphs, and context management for constrained inference environments. My current research centers on neuro-symbolic architectures and context/memory efficiency in Small Language Models (SLMs). I work across both industry engagements and academic research, and welcome collaboration inquiries, particularly around the Cascade Context Protocol.

[GitHub](https://github.com/eddcben) · [charafeddineben@gmail.com](mailto:charafeddineben@gmail.com)
